name: VariaPilot for WooCommerce
author: variapilot

sections.description:
VariaPilot for WooCommerce is a bulk variation manager designed to save time when working with multiple variable products.

Instead of opening each WooCommerce product and editing its variations one by one, VariaPilot lets you select several products, choose their global attributes, define the combinations you want to target, and preview the operation before applying it.

It is useful for stores that regularly need to create or update many WooCommerce product variations while keeping control over prices, stock, dimensions, shipping data, and publication status.

Bulk manage WooCommerce variations

VariaPilot provides one clear workspace for the main variation-management tasks:

  • Create missing WooCommerce variation combinations in bulk.
  • Edit existing variations across multiple variable products.
  • Disable matching variations without deleting them.
  • Permanently delete matching variations after confirmation.
  • Preview the number of products and variations affected before processing.

Select the products you want to update

You do not need to know product IDs.

Products can be selected using:

  • Product categories.
  • Product tags.
  • Product name search.

This makes it easier to target a collection, product range, brand group, or any other set of variable products already organised in WooCommerce.

Work with up to four global attributes

Select between one and four global WooCommerce attributes and define the combinations VariaPilot should create or modify.

For example, you can work with combinations such as:

  • Size.
  • Colour.
  • Material.
  • Format.

VariaPilot uses global attributes created under Products > Attributes in WooCommerce.

Edit only the fields you need

When modifying existing variations, fields left blank are not overwritten.

Depending on the operation, you can manage:

  • Regular price.
  • Variation description.
  • Weight.
  • Length, width, and height.
  • Publication status.
  • Stock management.
  • Stock quantity.
  • Backorders.
  • Shipping class.

This helps prevent accidental changes to variation data that should remain untouched.

Preview before processing

Before a bulk operation runs, VariaPilot shows a preview of the products and variations that will be affected.

Large operations are processed in batches to provide a more reliable workflow inside the WordPress administration area.

Undo recent variation creation

Variations created by the latest recoverable creation operation can be removed using the built-in undo function.

Modifications and permanent deletions cannot be undone, so a database backup is strongly recommended before large operations.

Privacy and data

VariaPilot does not send your store, product, customer, or variation data to an external service.

Bulk operations are performed within your own WordPress and WooCommerce installation.
sections.installation:
1. Install VariaPilot from Plugins > Add New in WordPress, or upload the plugin ZIP manually.
  2. Activate VariaPilot for WooCommerce.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Create any required global attributes under Products > Attributes.
  5. Open Products > VariaPilot.
  6. Select an operation, choose the products and attributes, then preview the changes before processing.

For large modifications or permanent deletions, make a database backup first.
sections.faq:
What does VariaPilot do?

VariaPilot lets you create, edit, disable, and delete WooCommerce product variations in bulk across multiple variable products from one administration screen.

Does VariaPilot require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I manage several products at the same time?

Yes. VariaPilot is specifically designed to apply variation operations across multiple variable products.

Do I need to know the WooCommerce product IDs?

No. You can select products by category, product tags, or by searching for their names.

How many attributes can I use?

You can select between one and four global WooCommerce attributes.

Can I use only one attribute?

Yes. VariaPilot works with one, two, three, or four global attributes.

Does editing variations overwrite every field?

No. During a modification, only the fields you complete are changed. Fields left blank keep their existing values.

Are weight and dimensions required?

No. Weight and dimensions are optional.

Can VariaPilot manage stock?

Yes. Variation operations can include stock management, stock quantity, backorders, and shipping class where applicable.

Can I preview a bulk operation before running it?

Yes. VariaPilot displays a preview of the products and variations that will be affected before processing.

Can I undo an operation?

Variations created by the latest recoverable creation operation can be removed with the undo function.

Modifications and permanent deletions cannot be undone, so make a database backup before large or destructive operations.

Does VariaPilot send my store data to an external service?

No. Product and variation operations are performed locally within your WordPress and WooCommerce installation.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Made all bulk variation operations available without a license or feature lock.
  • Added support for up to four global attributes.
  • Added product selection by tags.
  • Added bulk modification, disabling, and permanent deletion.
  • Added stock, backorder, and shipping class controls.
  • Removed external licensing and update SDK code from the WordPress.org package.
  • Updated the plugin metadata and WordPress.org contributor information.
